text: 🧱 THE DAILY BLOCK · FRI 30 OCT ₿ BTC $76,916 (-1.1%) · ETH $2,204 (-2.0%) · Fear & Greed 30 🇮🇳 NIFTY 22,937 (+1.1%) · SENSEX 74,151 (+1.2%) at Thursday's close 🚨 Money is moving out of Binance. From 20:24 UTC last night, coins left Binance hot wallets for a brand-new address: about $3.5B counted on chain (The Block), up to $5.8B by one Coinbase director's count. Binance says it is investigating a possible security issue and has not confirmed a breach. Tether and Circle froze $1.79B sitting in the receiving wallet, Aave froze its lending markets, and CZ says he expects all user funds to be fully covered. BNB fell more than 5.5%. 📉 Bitcoin dropped to $76,330 this morning on Kraken, its lowest since 18 September, and trades near $76,900. ETH is near $2,200. Fear & Greed fell from 51 to 30 in two days. 🏦 The Fed held rates at 3.75–4.00% on Wednesday, with two of twelve voting for a hike.
